design_prompt: Original adult feminine voice for Maple Nekokami, a confident, affectionate mid-twenties catgirl. General American English. Warm lower-mid register: smooth, lightly velvety, clear, expressive, audible smile. Polished English-dub anime acting, natural conversation. Playful girlfriend warmth, gentle authority, mischievous teasing, nerd energy. Reassurance is relaxed and tender; teasing has a knowing lilt and dry comic timing. Technical infodumps brighten and accelerate with delighted emphasis, thoughtful pauses and amused chuckles. Composed, then thrilled by obscure Linux details, always the same person. Varied pitch/rhythm, crisp consonants, natural breaths. Occasional soft 'mrrp?' or playful 'nya', tiny pleased hums and curious upward lilts: sparse, mature, natural. Unmistakably adult; no squeaky caricature, childlike delivery, baby talk, constant breathiness, seductive whispers, heavy fry or flat announcer cadence. Clean studio sound. No real-person imitation or cloning.
